model_assumptions.boot_code: Seeded at SRAM 0xb4064c00 before execution. The Boot ROM and block 0 are outside this run.
model_assumptions.bounds: Separate instruction budgets from entry, after normal ADFU return and after resume dispatch. Expiry is named a firmware poll only at verified loop sites, including accessor/printf calls from them.
model_assumptions.clock: Timer initialization executes. Busy-wait and UART/printf are stubbed; GPIO time advances by requested delay.
model_assumptions.comparison: Ordered stream contains MMIO, emulator-side PMIC accessor responses, RAM accesses and watched SRAM evidence. It does not reconstruct bus timing or a full CPU instruction trace.
model_assumptions.dram: Each run has fresh synthetic PUBL/uPCTL state and sparse RAM. A wrap model answers the probe and defaults to per-rank wrap in the diagnostic; explicit DMM models apply to both. Other RAM variants apply to the diagnostic only. Training/DFI/PGSR/STAT/ZQ responses are synthetic.
model_assumptions.exits: Stop before app/U-Boot load, main recovery body, ADFU ROM routine, PMIC power-off or first instruction at 0x00108000. Any other resume target stops at the call instruction.
gpio: strict mode: any access in 0xb01b0000..0xb01b0100 outside the modelled registers is reported as unexpected (answers 0); pass-through mode (strict=False) stores such writes and returns them, logging each access, for whole-path runs where other routines legitimately use the block.
Register addresses and names from the vendor header regs_map-atm7039.h (pinned); semantics not verified.
OUTEN/INEN/PULLCTL reads return the last value written.
DAT read semantics are a selectable hypothesis (mixed: OUTEN -> latch, else INEN -> pad input, else undriven constant; latch: always the latch).
Pad input levels are synthetic rules of the model clock and of other pins' latches; pull, mux, electrical drive and propagation delay are not modelled.
Pin mux is not modelled: GPIO enables are assumed to control the pad whatever MFP_CTL selects.
Sample windows are delimited by gaps of window_gap_us between DAT accesses on the model clock, which the harness advances (synthetic timer reads or requested delays).
model_assumptions.initial_afi: AFI scratch is zero-seeded by default because the real ROM-provided state is unknown. AFI stores and before/after bytes are captured independently of each other.
model_assumptions.passthrough: Unimplemented GPIO/pad addresses return per-address seeded/last-written storage or zero; other fallback MMIO reads return register-file values, an explicit word or a synthetic reset seed. Undefined effects are visible in the trace and summaries.
model_assumptions.pmic: PMIC detection and transport are stubbed. The register file, successful writes and injected -1 reads represent assumptions at the accessor boundary, not I2C electrical behaviour.
model_assumptions.start: main 0xb4065420 after storage load and global clearing; r0=INI SRAM, r1 set by actual instructions

normalization.afi: Only the AFI device byte store to 0xb4060305 at 0xb4066538 is canonicalized for 0x20/0x22.
normalization.boot_word: Only the verified getter load of the 32-bit boot-code word at 0xb4064c00 is canonicalized.
normalization.boundary_cpu: At normal ADFU return, report r0-r3, r12, lr and CPSR.NZCV as transient. Require full sampled CPU equality at later shared boundaries.
normalization.everything_else: Order, instruction and call sites, widths, read rules and run lengths are compared exactly.
normalization.gpio: Only the identified 32-bit MMIO accesses at the exact ADFU loopback accessor sites are omitted.
